values.summary: Inventory authoritative current surfaces, update v0.92 documentation and version declarations, preserve historical evidence, run focused parity and structure proof, then obtain exact-revision review.

steps.action: Build and review the classified canonical-surface and version-authority inventory
Update current documentation, feature inventory, links, and authoritative version metadata without historical drift
Run focused structure, parity, historical-negative, and exact-revision review proof

affected_areas: Canonical documentation indexes and feature inventory
Current milestone, tooling, skill, and runbook entrypoints
invariants: v0.92 active does not mean v0.92 features complete
v0.91.8 remains the latest completed release until separate release authority changes it
Historical evidence retains original versions and claims
No tracked work on main and no generated-file hand editing
risks: A broad replacement rewrites historical truth
Version declarations drift across workspace members
Current links point to absent or operator-local paths
stop_conditions: Historical-preservation scan reports a rewritten evidence surface
Protected-path collision with another active issue
replan_triggers: A current surface is owned by another open v0.92 issue
Executable version behavior changes and requires broader proof
The active prompt-template or workspace version authority changes before execution
